# config: chrome: disable Chrome's two-finger back/forward navigation

Turn off Chrome's two-finger swipe for back/forward. **Motivation:** false positives in Miro and other canvas-style web apps, where a horizontal pan triggers navigation and loses the page state. The fix from the [Apple StackExchange answer](https://apple.stackexchange.com/questions/21236/how-do-i-disable-chromes-two-finger-back-forward-navigation) is a preference write:

```
defaults write com.google.Chrome AppleEnableSwipeNavigateWithScrolls -bool false
```
